value.author: samMularczyk
value.layerInfo: Convert between rectangular and polar coordinates.

mapping: Rect to Polar wraps rows into rings, with the top edge at the centre. Polar to Rect unwraps rings into rows.
interpolation: Blends the remapped coordinate against the original one. 0 is a passthrough.
centre: Offset of the polar origin from the layer centre, in pixels.
angleOffset: Rotates the angular axis, moving where the seam falls.
tileMode: What happens outside the source: Clamp holds the edge, Repeat wraps, Mirror folds.
amount: Mix back to the unfiltered input.
